title: Los incas
goal: Read in depth about how the Inca state functioned without writing or money, from knotted-cord records to a royal estate rediscovered in 1911.

items: Explain how quipus recorded information without a writing system.
Describe the Qhapaq Ñan road network and the chasqui relay system.
Explain why each new Sapa Inca had to conquer his own land.
Describe what makes Moray's terraces unusual.
Use an opening gerund to describe the method behind a historical achievement.
